recognize_zh: 視野中可比較：右上中性球顆粒密集（約 3 分），左上中性球只有稀疏細小藍點（約 1 分），右下中性球無藍色顆粒（0 分），中左圓核細胞為淋巴球，不列入評分。
features: Upper right neutrophil with dense blue granules over red nucleus (about 3+)
Upper left neutrophil with sparse fine blue granules (about 1+)
Lower right band/segmented neutrophil without granules (0)
Round-nucleated lymphocyte (left) with no reaction product, excluded from scoring
describe_en: High-power view of a leukocyte alkaline phosphatase-stained peripheral blood smear shows neutrophils with differing reactivity. One neutrophil has dense blue granules (approximately 3+), another has only sparse fine granules (approximately 1+), and a third lacks reaction product (0). A lymphocyte with a round red nucleus is present and is not included in the count. This field illustrates the per-cell grading used to derive the LAP score.

ddx.vs: 4+ cells show confluent precipitate that completely obscures the nucleus, not seen here.
Monocytes have a single folded nucleus and are excluded from the LAP score even if weakly stained.
